drafts.title: OPP-2001 Northwind — Discovery call update
drafts.content:
NEXT STEPS
- Send proposed technical demo slots today (focus: reporting + definition governance).
- Demo to explicitly address the MQL definition conflict (champion called this the room-winner).
- Target demo next week; demonstrable value required before Mar 15 board review.

STAGE RATIONALE
- Keep at Discovery → ready to move to Qualification once budget and demo are confirmed. Pain is clear and a compelling event exists.

QUALIFICATION SIGNALS
- Metrics/Pain: Untrusted pipeline numbers; reps don't log next steps; stale close dates. (Qualitative — quantify next.)
- Economic Buyer: COO Dana Liu signs anything >$25K. Jordan Pike (VP RevOps) recommends.
- Budget: ~$40K earmarked for the platform piece this year; could grow if cleanup proves out.
- Timeline/Compelling event: Board review end of Q1; needs something demonstrable before Mar 15.
- Competition: Evaluated Acme; felt their data-hygiene tooling was thin.
- Champion: Jordan Pike (VP RevOps).

GAPS TO CAPTURE
- Quantified metric for the reporting pain (e.g. forecast error %, hours lost).
- Confirm whether the $40K is approved budget or an estimate.
